dataSource: City of Minnetonka building permit records
notes: Covers Building permits with recorded valuation only — excludes $0-valuation and permit-type categories outside Building (no separate electrical/plumbing/mechanical feed yet).
Data is a static extract refreshed manually, not a live city API — the most recent 1–2 months may be incomplete.
summary: Minnetonka is covered by a direct extract from the city's own permit system: nearly 25,000 building permits issued from May 2016 through May 2026, including almost 20,000 single-family filings — reroofs, remodels, additions, and repairs, matched by address.
